description: P6 Gantt Chart is a powerful and flexible project scheduling visual for Power BI. It is specifically designed to handle complex data from project management tools like Primavera P6, allowing you to visualize project timelines with high accuracy. Key Features Seamlessly visualize project schedules and task hierarchies. Optimized for Primavera P6 exported data. Customizable bar colors and milestone indicators. Interactive tooltips for quick insights. Ideal for Project Managers and stakeholders to track project progress. Setup Steps Copy the schedule data from Primavera P6 and paste it into Excel. Add a helper column named Sort and create a sequential number (SN) starting from 1. Import the Excel file into Power BI and connect the fields to the visual.
